R3.rule: alpha >= 0 and beta+lambda >= 0 healthy for all k; alpha < 0 ghost and beta+lambda < 0 gradient-unstable at large k (Lean SV2_repair)

R4_window.alpha2: proportional to (alpha - 2 beta) (literature); zero on that line
R4_window.finite_c_k: alpha > 0; c_k^2 = (beta+lambda) c^2/alpha; c_k <= c needs beta+lambda <= alpha
R4_window.edge_alpha=2beta: alpha <= 2.8e-15 on the alpha = 2 beta line; alpha <= 2.5e-5 off it (alpha1 only)
R4_window.status: LITERATURE, not re-derived on the v3s equations; the R1 verdict does not use it

R5.footings: identical in y = g/a0 (a0 is only the scale): canonical and alt both carry this number
